plugin.name: Tabular Review
plugin.description: Documents × questions → one review table. AI extracts answers in bulk, every cell links back to its source passage, and lawyers confirm or edit each cell before exporting to Excel.
view.main.name: Tabular Review
panel.title: Tabular Review
panel.subtitle: Pick documents, define questions, and let AI answer them document by document. Every cell links back to its source; confirm or edit, then export to Excel.
panel.files.heading: Documents
panel.files.empty: This project has no text-readable files (Word, PDF, Excel, PowerPoint, TXT and similar are supported).
panel.columns.heading: Questions
panel.columns.title: Column title
panel.columns.promptPlaceholder: Question to ask each document, e.g. Does the contract contain a change-of-control clause?
panel.tpl.contract.name: Commercial contract due diligence
panel.tpl.lease.name: Lease review
panel.tpl.blank.name: Blank (custom questions)
panel.tpl.contract.parties.title: Parties
panel.tpl.contract.parties.prompt: What are the full legal names of the contracting parties?
panel.tpl.contract.signDate.title: Signing date
panel.tpl.contract.signDate.prompt: On what date was the contract signed?
panel.tpl.contract.term.title: Term
panel.tpl.contract.term.prompt: What is the term of the contract (start and end dates, renewal)?
panel.tpl.contract.changeOfControl.title: Change of control
panel.tpl.contract.changeOfControl.promp: Does the contract contain a change-of-control clause (termination right or consent required if a party's control changes)?
panel.tpl.contract.assignment.title: Assignment restriction
panel.tpl.contract.assignment.prompt: Is assignment of rights and obligations prohibited without the other party's consent?
panel.tpl.contract.exclusivity.title: Exclusivity / non-compete
panel.tpl.contract.exclusivity.prompt: Does the contract impose exclusivity or non-compete obligations?
panel.tpl.contract.termination.title: Early termination
panel.tpl.contract.termination.prompt: Under what circumstances may a party terminate the contract early?
panel.tpl.contract.liabilityCap.title: Liability cap
panel.tpl.contract.liabilityCap.prompt: Is liability for breach or indemnity capped, and at what amount?
panel.tpl.contract.governingLaw.title: Governing law and disputes
panel.tpl.contract.governingLaw.prompt: What law governs the contract, and are disputes resolved by litigation or arbitration, and where?
panel.tpl.lease.landlord.title: Landlord
panel.tpl.lease.landlord.prompt: What is the landlord's full legal name?
panel.tpl.lease.tenant.title: Tenant
panel.tpl.lease.tenant.prompt: What is the tenant's full legal name?
panel.tpl.lease.premises.title: Premises
panel.tpl.lease.premises.prompt: What are the address and floor area of the premises?
panel.tpl.lease.leaseTerm.title: Lease term
panel.tpl.lease.leaseTerm.prompt: What are the start and end dates of the lease?
panel.tpl.lease.rent.title: Rent and payment
panel.tpl.lease.rent.prompt: What is the rent, how is it adjusted, and how is it paid?
panel.tpl.lease.deposit.title: Deposit
panel.tpl.lease.deposit.prompt: What is the amount of the deposit or security?
panel.tpl.lease.sublease.title: Subletting
panel.tpl.lease.sublease.prompt: Does subletting require the landlord's consent?
panel.tpl.lease.renewal.title: Renewal / first refusal
panel.tpl.lease.renewal.prompt: Is there a renewal option or a right of first refusal on equal terms?
panel.table.empty: Select documents and define questions above, then click Start extraction.
panel.row.truncated: Long document: only the first {n} parts were reviewed
panel.detail.noAnchor: This cell has no source passage.
panel.detail.unverifiedHint: The quote returned by AI was not found in the document, so the answer was discarded. Run extraction again or fill it in manually.
panel.run.safety: Extracted cells are saved as you go. You can resume after stopping; confirmed or edited cells are never overwritten.
panel.run.estimate: About {calls} AI calls (at most 10 per minute, roughly {minutes} min), charged to your Credits.
panel.run.nothing: Every cell already has a result. To re-extract a column, edit its question.
panel.run.finished: Extraction finished. Check each cell against its source before confirming.
panel.run.stopped: Stopped. Click Start extraction again to resume the unfinished cells.
panel.export.question: Question
panel.err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
panel.err.upgrade: This version of AI WorkDeck does not support this feature. Please upgrade.
panel.err.permission: The plugin lacks a required permission.
panel.err.noColumns: Add at least one question and fill in the question text for every column.
panel.err.tooManyFiles: A review table can hold at most {n} documents.
panel.err.tooManyColumns: A review table can hold at most {n} questions.
panel.err.emptyText: No text could be read (run OCR on scanned files first).
panel.err.storageFull: The review table exceeds the plugin storage limit and may be lost when the panel closes. Export to Excel now.
